script.source: #!/bin/bash set -x exec >>/var/log/openinfra-provision.log 2>&1 echo "=== openinfra provision $(date -u) on @@HOSTNAME@@ ===" # root SSH key (done here, not in <users>, to avoid schema risk) mkdir -p /root/.ssh; chmod 700 /root/.ssh echo '@@SSH_PUBKEY@@' > /root/.ssh/authorized_keys; chmod 600 /root/.ssh/authorized_keys systemctl enable sshd chronyd || true systemctl disable --now firewalld 2>/dev/null || true # SLE15 firewalld blocks RKE2/Canal ports (appendix D5) # RKE2 (server) mkdir -p /etc/rancher/rke2 cat >/etc/rancher/rke2/config.yaml <<CFG token: @@RKE2_TOKEN@@ @@SERVER_LINE@@ node-label: - "openinfra.dev/chaos=true" write-kubeconfig-mode: "0644" CFG curl -sfL https://get.rke2.io -o /root/get-rke2.sh && sh /root/get-rke2.sh # NOTE: rke2-server is deliberately NOT enabled here. The FIPS one-shot below enables it, so rke2 only # ever starts (and joins etcd) AFTER the fips=1 reboot — i.e. FIPS-FIRST. Starting rke2 pre-FIPS and # rebooting an etcd member for FIPS afterwards breaks etcd quorum on multi-server joins (learned the # hard way). FIPS packages are installed at main-install time via <software><packages> so the one-shot # needs no zypper (which YaST holds locked on first boot). NOTE: FIPS mode disables Ed25519 for SSH, so # the injected authorized key is ECDSA (nistp256, FIPS-approved) — see render.sh. (Version-locking to # the FIPS-validated RPM builds is a deliberate follow-on, runbook Step 4.) cat >/etc/systemd/system/openinfra-fips.service <<'UNIT' [Unit] Description=openinfra one-shot: enable FIPS + enable rke2, then reboot into fips=1 After=network-online.target Wants=network-online.target ConditionPathExists=!/var/lib/openinfra-fips.done [Service] Type=oneshot RemainAfterExit=yes ExecStart=/bin/bash -c 'fips-mode-setup --enable && systemctl enable rke2-server.service && touch /var/lib/openinfra-fips.done && systemctl disable openinfra-fips.service && systemctl reboot' [Install] WantedBy=multi-user.target UNIT systemctl enable openinfra-fips.service echo "=== provision done (boot1: enable FIPS+rke2 then reboot; boot2: rke2 joins under fips=1) ==="
